{{Top|leg}}
The '''Meerian style''' was a typical [[Hair/Legends|hairstyle]] that was popular among the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerians]] from [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This type of haircut was characterized by the cropping of the hair in tufts.
